measurement.sql:
WITH child_input AS (SELECT "congress", "chamber", "event_id" FROM read_parquet(['https://pub-72e95c0c20a84508b42b03a6ff6d55f8.r2.dev/generations/committee-reports/607484a1c1e29358d36adf33a94852e26500531d6b6c7212669c1451d31a8aba/hearing_transcripts.parquet'], hive_partitioning = false)),
             parent_input AS (SELECT "congress", "chamber", "event_id" FROM read_parquet(['https://pub-72e95c0c20a84508b42b03a6ff6d55f8.r2.dev/generations/committee-meetings/56ff898668032314e79d08fd9823e07b0591fc08365a06c4940c4af44364e06b/committee_meetings.parquet'], hive_partitioning = false)),
             c AS (SELECT "congress" AS c0, "chamber" AS c1, "event_id" AS c2, count(*) AS child_rows
                   FROM child_input WHERE "congress" IS NOT NULL AND "chamber" IS NOT NULL AND "event_id" IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY ALL),
             p AS (SELECT "congress" AS p0, "chamber" AS p1, "event_id" AS p2, count(*) AS parent_rows
                   FROM parent_input WHERE "congress" IS NOT NULL AND "chamber" IS NOT NULL AND "event_id" IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY ALL),
             j AS (SELECT c0, c1, c2, child_rows, coalesce(parent_rows, 0) AS parent_rows
                   FROM c LEFT JOIN p ON c.c0 = p.p0 AND c.c1 = p.p1 AND c.c2 = p.p2)
        SELECT count(*) AS keys, count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_rows=0) AS missing,
               (list(concat_ws('|', c0, c1, c2) ORDER BY c0, c1, c2) FILTER (WHERE parent_rows=0))[1:3] AS examples,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM child_input) AS child_input_rows,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows),0) AS child_nonnull_rows,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_input) AS parent_input_rows,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM p) AS parent_distinct_keys,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM p WHERE parent_rows>1) AS parent_duplicate_keys,
               coalesce((SELECT max(parent_rows) FROM p),0) AS max_parent_multiplicity,
               coalesce(max(parent_rows),0) AS max_matched_parent_multiplicity,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows*parent_rows),0) AS inner_join_rows,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows*greatest(parent_rows,1)),0) AS left_join_nonnull_rows
        FROM j
